sources.quote: The distance to HD 3167 can be determined from its annual parallax shift of 21.1363 mas as measured by the Gaia space observatory, yielding a range of 154 light years.

introduction.text: It is one of 4 planets known around HD 3167. Its orbit and size follow Coy et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
